title: Security: Spoofing location object by overriding Symbol.toPrimitive
description_snippet:
**VULNERABILITY DETAILS**   
  
Chrome allows to spoof the location object by overriding `Object.prototype[Symbol.toPrimitive]`.  
  
You can test this behavior from the following code:  
  
Object.prototype[Symbol.toPrimitive]=function(){return "https://www.google.com/"}  
alert(location)//returns
